paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -3.78% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (-2.26%) and Hang Seng weakest (-4.86%). Brent crude changed -5.97% to 90.1. Gold changed -4.16% to 3,723.5. Bitcoin changed -0.73% to 63,660.2305. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.095%, a relative move of -0.16%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (-17.18%) and BHP (-14.29%) moved the most.
